definitions.explanation: A woman who manages a household as her primary occupation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧{主婦|しゅふ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My mother is a full-time homemaker.

examples.japanese: {主婦|しゅふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{主婦|しゅふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got better at cooking after becoming a homemaker.

examples.english: She studies at university while being a homemaker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{主婦|しゅふ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦こなしている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容易|ようい}→容易：12316_youi⟧⟦では→では：noentry⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: She works while also being a homemaker. Balancing housework, childcare, and a job is not easy.

notes:
{主婦|しゅふ} refers to a housewife or homemaker - typically a woman who manages the household.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧{主婦|しゅふ} (full-time homemaker)
- ⟦{兼業|けんぎょう}→兼業：08562_kengyou⟧{主婦|しゅふ} (working mother/homemaker with a job)
- {主婦|しゅふ}⟦{業|ぎょう}→業：noentry⟧ (homemaking, housework as work)
- ⟦{新米|しんまい}→新米：06877_shinmai⟧{主婦|しゅふ} (new homemaker)

GENDER-NEUTRAL ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦{主夫|しゅふ}→主夫：30802_shufu⟧: househusband (same reading, different kanji)
- ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→者：04662_sha⟧: person in charge of housework

CULTURAL NOTE:
While {主婦|しゅふ} traditionally referred to women, the term ⟦{主夫|しゅふ}→主夫：30802_shufu⟧ (written with ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ "husband") is increasingly used for men who stay home to manage the household.
